items.snippet_en: NDTV reported that ISRO announced the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft was scheduled to make its soft landing on the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, at approximately 18:04 IST.

Space.com stated that India's Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft was scheduled to touch down near the lunar south pole on Wednesday, August 23, around 8:34 a.m. EDT (1234 GMT; 6:04 p.m. Indian Standard Time, or IST).

The Guardian reported that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon, with the Vikram lander touching down shortly after 6pm (1230 BST) on August 23, 2023.
PBS stated that India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on Wednesday, August 23, making it the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region.

Sky & Telescope reported that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully soft-landed in the lunar south pole region of the Moon on August 23rd, making India the first nation to successfully touch down in that region.
NASA Science confirmed that Chandrayaan-3 is an Indian Space Research Organization mission that landed near the south pole of the Moon on August 23, 2023.

The Business Standard reported that India became the fourth country in the world to perform a soft landing on the moon on August 23, 2023, joining Russia, the United States, and China.
Wikipedia states that with this landing, ISRO became the fourth national space agency to successfully land on the Moon, after the Soviet space program, NASA, and CNSA.
